queries.sql: WITH unified_returns AS (SELECT cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr_return_quantity AS return_qty, cr_return_amount AS return_amt, cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk FROM catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT sr_item_sk AS item_sk, sr_return_quantity AS return_qty, sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS return_amt, sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk FROM store_returns), item_agg AS (SELECT item_sk, SUM(return_qty) AS total_return_qty, SUM(return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_events FROM unified_returns GROUP BY item_sk), ranked_items AS (SELECT item_sk, total_return_qty, total_return_amt, return_events, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS rn FROM item_agg) SELECT item_sk, total_return_qty, total_return_amt, return_events FROM ranked_items WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC

WITH catalog_monthly AS (SELECT (CAST(cr_returned_date_sk / 100 AS INTEGER) % 100) AS month, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss, SUM(cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amt, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS catalog_return_qty FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY (CAST(cr_returned_date_sk / 100 AS INTEGER) % 100)), store_monthly AS (SELECT (CAST(sr_returned_date_sk / 100 AS INTEGER) % 100) AS month, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss, SUM(sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS store_return_amt, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS store_return_qty FROM store_returns GROUP BY (CAST(sr_returned_date_sk / 100 AS INTEGER) % 100)), combined_monthly AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.month, s.month) AS month, COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(s.store_net_loss,0) AS total_net_loss, COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amt,0) + COALESCE(s.store_return_amt,0) AS total_return_amt, COALESCE(c.catalog_return_qty,0) + COALESCE(s.store_return_qty,0) AS total_return_qty FROM catalog_monthly c FULL OUTER JOIN store_monthly s ON c.month = s.month) SELECT month, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'HighLoss' ELSE 'LowLoss' END AS loss_category, ROUND(SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),2) AS three_month_moving_net_loss, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM combined_monthly ORDER BY month

WITH catalog_loss AS (SELECT cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS catalog_return_qty, SUM(cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amt FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_reason_sk), store_loss AS (SELECT sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS store_return_qty, SUM(sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS store_return_amt FROM store_returns GROUP BY sr_reason_sk) SELECT r.r_reason_desc, COALESCE(cl.catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(sl.store_net_loss,0) AS total_net_loss, COALESCE(cl.catalog_return_qty,0) + COALESCE(sl.store_return_qty,0) AS total_return_qty, (COALESCE(cl.catalog_return_amt,0) + COALESCE(sl.store_return_amt,0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(cl.catalog_return_qty,0) + COALESCE(sl.store_return_qty,0),0) AS avg_return_amount, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(cl.catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(sl.store_net_loss,0)) > 100000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END AS loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(cl.catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(sl.store_net_loss,0)) DESC) AS loss_rank FROM reason r LEFT JOIN catalog_loss cl ON r.r_reason_sk = cl.reason_sk LEFT JOIN store_loss sl ON r.r_reason_sk = sl.reason_sk ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC

WITH store_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, AVG(sr.sr_store_credit) AS avg_store_credit, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk), store_top_reason AS (SELECT sr_store_sk, r_reason_desc, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc) t), store_gender_dist AS (SELECT sr_store_sk, cd_gender, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn_gender FROM (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, cd.cd_gender) t) SELECT s.sr_store_sk, s.total_returns, s.total_store_credit, ROUND(s.avg_store_credit,2) AS avg_store_credit, s.total_net_loss, CASE WHEN s.avg_store_credit > 2000 THEN 'HighCredit' ELSE 'LowCredit' END AS credit_category, tr.r_reason_desc AS top_reason, gd.cd_gender AS top_gender, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM store_agg s LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr_store_sk, r_reason_desc FROM store_top_reason WHERE rn = 1) tr ON s.sr_store_sk = tr.sr_store_sk LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr_store_sk, cd_gender FROM store_gender_dist WHERE rn_gender = 1) gd ON s.sr_store_sk = gd.sr_store_sk ORDER BY s.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_demo AS (SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS catalog_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS catalog_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating), store_demo AS (SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS store_refunded_cash, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating), combined_demo AS (SELECT COALESCE(c1.cd_gender, c2.cd_gender) AS gender, COALESCE(c1.cd_marital_status, c2.cd_marital_status) AS marital_status, COALESCE(c1.cd_credit_rating, c2.cd_credit_rating) AS credit_rating, COALESCE(catalog_refunded_cash,0) + COALESCE(store_refunded_cash,0) AS total_refunded_cash, COALESCE(catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(store_net_loss,0) AS total_net_loss, COALESCE(catalog_return_qty,0) + COALESCE(store_return_qty,0) AS total_return_qty, COALESCE(catalog_return_cnt,0) + COALESCE(store_return_cnt,0) AS total_return_cnt FROM catalog_demo c1 FULL OUTER JOIN store_demo c2 ON c1.cd_gender = c2.cd_gender AND c1.cd_marital_status = c2.cd_marital_status AND c1.cd_credit_rating = c2.cd_credit_rating) SELECT gender, marital_status, credit_rating, total_refunded_cash, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, total_refunded_cash / NULLIF(total_return_cnt,0) AS avg_refunded_per_return, CASE WHEN total_refunded_cash / NULLIF(total_return_cnt,0) > 500 THEN 'HighRefund' ELSE 'LowRefund' END AS refund_category, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss) AS net_loss_percentile, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_refunded_cash DESC) AS refunded_cash_rank FROM combined_demo ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC

WITH customer_returns AS (SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, MAX(cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk) AS cd_demo_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fees FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk), most_common_reason AS (SELECT customer_sk, cr_reason_sk, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk) t), customer_demo AS (SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating FROM customer_demographics cd) SELECT cr.customer_sk, cr.return_cnt, cr.total_net_loss, cr.total_return_qty, cr.avg_return_amt, d.cd_gender, d.cd_marital_status, d.cd_credit_rating, r.r_reason_desc AS top_reason, CASE WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 0 WHEN cr.total_return_qty > 100 THEN 10 WHEN d.cd_credit_rating = 'A' THEN 20 ELSE 5 END AS health_score_adjust, (100 - FLOOR(cr.total_net_loss / 1000) - FLOOR(cr.total_return_qty * 0.2) + CASE WHEN d.cd_credit_rating = 'A' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END) AS health_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (100 - FLOOR(cr.total_net_loss / 1000) - FLOOR(cr.total_return_qty * 0.2) + CASE WHEN d.cd_credit_rating = 'A' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS health_rank FROM customer_returns cr LEFT JOIN most_common_reason mr ON cr.customer_sk = mr.customer_sk AND mr.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN reason r ON mr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demo d ON cr.cd_demo_sk = d.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY health_score DESC LIMIT 20

WITH all_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_quantity AS quantity, cs.cs_order_number AS order_number, 'Catalog' AS channel FROM catalog_sales cs UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid, ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit, ws.ws_quantity AS quantity, ws.ws_order_number AS order_number, 'Web' AS channel FROM web_sales ws), customer_agg AS (SELECT customer_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS num_orders, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(net_paid) AS avg_order_value, MAX(sold_date_sk) AS last_purchase_date FROM all_sales GROUP BY customer_sk) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.num_orders, ca.total_net_paid, ca.total_net_profit, ca.total_quantity, ca.avg_order_value, ca.last_purchase_date, CASE WHEN ca.total_net_paid >= 20000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN ca.total_net_paid BETWEEN 10000 AND 19999.99 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS tier, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN ca.total_net_paid >= 20000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN ca.total_net_paid BETWEEN 10000 AND 19999.99 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END ORDER BY ca.total_net_paid DESC) AS tier_rank FROM customer_agg ca JOIN customer c ON ca.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE ca.num_orders > 0 ORDER BY tier, tier_rank LIMIT 30

WITH time_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, 'Catalog' AS channel, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS preferred_flag FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk, ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid, 'Web' AS channel, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS preferred_flag FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk), agg AS (SELECT ts.time_sk, ts.channel, SUM(ts.net_paid) AS total_net_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.preferred_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_customer_cnt FROM time_sales ts GROUP BY ts.time_sk, ts.channel) SELECT a.time_sk, a.channel, a.total_net_paid, a.total_net_paid / NULLIF(a.distinct_customers,0) AS avg_net_paid_per_customer, CASE WHEN a.total_net_paid > 5000 THEN 'High' WHEN a.total_net_paid BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS volume_category, AVG(a.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY a.channel ORDER BY a.time_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3_periods, a.preferred_customer_cnt * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.distinct_customers,0) AS pct_preferred_customers FROM agg a ORDER BY a.channel, a.time_sk LIMIT 200

WITH discount_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_order_number AS order_number, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, (cs.cs_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(cs.cs_ext_sales_price,0)) * 100 AS discount_pct, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, 'Catalog' AS channel FROM catalog_sales cs UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_order_number AS order_number, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(ws.ws_ext_sales_price,0)) * 100 AS discount_pct, ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid, 'Web' AS channel FROM web_sales ws) SELECT d.sold_date_sk, w.w_state, c.c_birth_country, CASE WHEN d.avg_discount_pct < 5 THEN 'Low Discount' WHEN d.avg_discount_pct BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'High Discount' END AS discount_bucket, d.order_cnt, d.total_net_paid, d.avg_discount_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.sold_date_sk ORDER BY d.avg_discount_pct DESC) AS discount_rank FROM (SELECT ds.sold_date_sk, ds.warehouse_sk, ds.customer_sk, AVG(ds.discount_pct) AS avg_discount_pct, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(ds.net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM discount_sales ds GROUP BY ds.sold_date_sk, ds.warehouse_sk, ds.customer_sk) d JOIN warehouse w ON d.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN customer c ON d.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE d.order_cnt > 5 ORDER BY d.sold_date_sk DESC, discount_rank LIMIT 50

WITH cc_quarter AS (SELECT d_open.d_year, d_open.d_quarter_seq, d_open.d_quarter_name, SUM(cc.cc_employees) AS total_employees, AVG(cc.cc_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_percentage FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk GROUP BY d_open.d_year, d_open.d_quarter_seq, d_open.d_quarter_name) SELECT d_year, d_quarter_seq, d_quarter_name, total_employees, avg_tax_percentage, AVG(total_employees) OVER (ORDER BY d_quarter_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_employees_last_3_quarters, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_employees DESC) AS employee_rank, CASE WHEN total_employees > 1000 THEN 'Large' WHEN total_employees BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Small' END AS size_category FROM cc_quarter ORDER BY d_quarter_seq

WITH cust_dates AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_year AS birth_year, d_shipto.d_date AS shipto_date, d_review.d_date AS review_date, DATE_DIFF('day', d_shipto.d_date, d_review.d_date) AS days_between, CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d_shipto.d_date, d_review.d_date) < 30 THEN 'Less than 30 days' WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d_shipto.d_date, d_review.d_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 90 THEN '30-90 days' ELSE 'More than 90 days' END AS diff_bucket, cc.cc_tax_percentage FROM customer c LEFT JOIN date_dim d_shipto ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_shipto.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_review ON c.c_last_review_date = d_review.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_country = c.c_birth_country) SELECT c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, birth_year, shipto_date, review_date, days_between, diff_bucket, cc_tax_percentage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY diff_bucket ORDER BY days_between DESC) AS bucket_rnk, AVG(cc_tax_percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY diff_bucket) AS avg_tax_in_bucket FROM cust_dates WHERE days_between IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_bucket, bucket_rnk LIMIT 30

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, AVG(sc.d_year - sc.c_birth_year) AS avg_age_at_sale, cp.cp_type FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, distinct_customers, avg_age_at_sale, cp_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC) AS dept_customer_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_age_at_sale DESC) AS age_dense_rank FROM page_customers ORDER BY cp_department, dept_customer_rank LIMIT 20

WITH cc_info AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_division_name, cc.cc_employees, cc.cc_sq_ft, cc.cc_tax_percentage, d_open.d_year AS open_year, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_closed.d_year AS close_year, d_closed.d_date AS close_date, CASE WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage < 5 THEN 'Low' WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS tax_bracket, (cc.cc_employees * 1.0) / NULLIF(cc.cc_sq_ft, 0) AS emp_per_sqft FROM call_center cc LEFT JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_closed ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk), cc_agg AS (SELECT ci.cc_call_center_sk, ci.cc_name, ci.cc_division_name, ci.open_year, ci.close_year, ci.tax_bracket, ci.cc_employees, ci.cc_sq_ft, ci.emp_per_sqft, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ci.open_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date THEN cp.cp_catalog_page_sk END) AS catalog_page_count FROM cc_info ci LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk GROUP BY ci.cc_call_center_sk, ci.cc_name, ci.cc_division_name, ci.open_year, ci.close_year, ci.tax_bracket, ci.cc_employees, ci.cc_sq_ft, ci.emp_per_sqft, ci.open_date, ci.close_date) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_division_name, open_year, close_year, tax_bracket, cc_employees, cc_sq_ft, emp_per_sqft, catalog_page_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY emp_per_sqft DESC) AS emp_sqft_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY catalog_page_count DESC) AS catalog_page_rank FROM cc_agg ORDER BY emp_sqft_rank LIMIT 10

WITH new_customers AS (SELECT d_sales.d_year AS year, d_sales.d_moy AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS new_customers FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk GROUP BY d_sales.d_year, d_sales.d_moy), cc_month_stats AS (SELECT d_open.d_year AS year, d_open.d_moy AS month, AVG(cc.cc_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cc_call_center_sk) AS cc_count FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk GROUP BY d_open.d_year, d_open.d_moy) SELECT COALESCE(nc.year, cm.year) AS year, COALESCE(nc.month, cm.month) AS month, COALESCE(new_customers,0) AS new_customers, COALESCE(avg_tax_percentage,0) AS avg_tax_percentage, COALESCE(cc_count,0) AS cc_count, SUM(COALESCE(new_customers,0)) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(nc.year, cm.year), COALESCE(nc.month, cm.month)) AS cumulative_customers, AVG(COALESCE(avg_tax_percentage,0)) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(nc.year, cm.year), COALESCE(nc.month, cm.month) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_tax_last_3_months, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(new_customers,0) DESC) AS new_customers_rank, CASE WHEN COALESCE(nc.month, cm.month) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter' WHEN COALESCE(nc.month, cm.month) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring' WHEN COALESCE(nc.month, cm.month) IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer' ELSE 'Fall' END AS season FROM new_customers nc FULL OUTER JOIN cc_month_stats cm ON nc.year = cm.year AND nc.month = cm.month ORDER BY year, month

WITH cc_info AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_division, cc.cc_employees, cc.cc_tax_percentage, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_closed.d_date AS close_date, cc.cc_country FROM call_center cc LEFT JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_closed ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk), cp_overlap AS (SELECT ci.cc_call_center_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) AS overlapping_pages FROM cc_info ci LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk WHERE d_start.d_date <= ci.close_date AND d_end.d_date >= ci.open_date GROUP BY ci.cc_call_center_sk), cust_counts AS (SELECT ci.cc_call_center_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS related_customers FROM cc_info ci LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_birth_country = ci.cc_country GROUP BY ci.cc_call_center_sk) SELECT ci.cc_call_center_sk, ci.cc_name, ci.cc_division, ci.cc_employees, ci.cc_tax_percentage, ci.open_date, ci.close_date, COALESCE(co.overlapping_pages,0) AS overlapping_pages, COALESCE(ccc.related_customers,0) AS related_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(co.overlapping_pages,0) DESC) AS overlap_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.cc_division ORDER BY COALESCE(co.overlapping_pages,0) DESC) AS division_overlap_rank, AVG(ci.cc_employees) OVER (PARTITION BY ci.cc_division) AS avg_employees_in_div FROM cc_info ci LEFT JOIN cp_overlap co ON ci.cc_call_center_sk = co.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN cust_counts ccc ON ci.cc_call_center_sk = ccc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY overlap_rank LIMIT 15

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, AVG(sc.d_year - sc.c_birth_year) AS avg_age_at_sale FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, distinct_customers, avg_age_at_sale, LAG(distinct_customers) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY cp_catalog_page_number) AS prev_page_customers FROM page_customers WHERE distinct_customers IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number LIMIT 20

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, AVG(sc.d_year - sc.c_birth_year) AS avg_age_at_sale FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number) SELECT cp_department, SUM(distinct_customers) AS total_customers, AVG(avg_age_at_sale) AS avg_age_across_pages FROM page_customers GROUP BY cp_department HAVING SUM(distinct_customers) > 10 ORDER BY total_customers DESC LIMIT 20

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_type, distinct_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC) AS overall_rank FROM page_customers WHERE distinct_customers > 5 ORDER BY overall_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk WHERE d_sales.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, COUNT(sc.c_customer_sk) AS total_sales, SUM(sc.d_year - sc.c_birth_year) AS total_age_at_sale FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, total_sales, total_age_at_sale, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_percent_rank FROM page_customers ORDER BY cp_department, sales_percent_rank DESC LIMIT 20

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, COUNT(sc.c_customer_sk) AS total_sales_customers FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_type, total_sales_customers, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_sales_customers DESC) AS dept_rank FROM page_customers WHERE total_sales_customers BETWEEN 5 AND 50 ORDER BY dept_rank, total_sales_customers DESC LIMIT 25

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, MIN(sc.d_year) AS first_sale_year, MAX(sc.d_year) AS last_sale_year FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_year BETWEEN d_start.d_year AND d_end.d_year GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_type, distinct_customers, first_sale_year, last_sale_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC) AS rn FROM page_customers WHERE distinct_customers >= 10 ORDER BY rn LIMIT 10

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_month, d_sales.d_date FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(CASE WHEN sc.c_birth_month IN (12,1,2) THEN 1 END) AS winter_births FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_type, distinct_customers, winter_births, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY winter_births DESC) AS winter_rank FROM page_customers WHERE distinct_customers >= 5 ORDER BY winter_rank, distinct_customers DESC LIMIT 12

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, d_sales.d_date FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) BETWEEN 5 AND 20) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_type, distinct_customers, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY distinct_customers) AS quartile FROM page_customers ORDER BY quartile, distinct_customers DESC LIMIT 40

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1990), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.c_birth_year < 1980 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_birth_customers FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_type, distinct_customers, early_birth_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC) AS overall_rank FROM page_customers WHERE distinct_customers > 3 ORDER BY overall_rank, cp_department LIMIT 15

WITH categorized AS (SELECT CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN 'No Vehicle' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1-2 Vehicles' ELSE '3+ Vehicles' END AS vehicle_category, CASE WHEN d.d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Non-Holiday' END AS holiday_flag, wr.wr_return_quantity, wr.wr_return_amt, wr.wr_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk) SELECT vehicle_category, holiday_flag, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(wr_return_quantity) / SUM(SUM(wr_return_quantity)) OVER (PARTITION BY holiday_flag), 2) AS pct_of_qty_by_holiday FROM categorized GROUP BY vehicle_category, holiday_flag ORDER BY vehicle_category, holiday_flag

WITH monthly_returns AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_current_month, ib.ib_income_band_sk AS ib_income_band_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_tax, CASE WHEN d.d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Non-Holiday' END AS holiday_flag FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_current_month, ib.ib_income_band_sk, d.d_holiday) SELECT d_year, d_current_month, ib_income_band_sk, total_return_amt, total_tax, holiday_flag, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS month_rank FROM monthly_returns ORDER BY d_year, ib_income_band_sk, month_rank

SELECT d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_day_name, ib.ib_income_band_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, (SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0)) AS loss_ratio, AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_cnt, AVG(hd.hd_dep_count) AS avg_dep_cnt, CASE WHEN d.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend, ib.ib_income_band_sk HAVING SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 0 ORDER BY net_loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH daily_returns AS (SELECT d.d_date, ib.ib_income_band_sk AS ib_income_band_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, ib.ib_income_band_sk) SELECT d_date, ib_income_band_sk, daily_return_amt, SUM(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amt, AVG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d FROM daily_returns ORDER BY ib_income_band_sk, d_date

WITH quarter_returns AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, ib.ib_income_band_sk AS ib_income_band_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, ib.ib_income_band_sk), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM quarter_returns) SELECT qr.d_year, qr.d_quarter_seq, qr.ib_income_band_sk, qr.total_return_amt, qr.total_net_loss, CASE WHEN qr.total_net_loss > os.avg_net_loss THEN 'High Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY qr.d_year ORDER BY qr.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank_within_year FROM quarter_returns qr CROSS JOIN overall_stats os ORDER BY qr.d_year, loss_rank_within_year

WITH unified_items AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, 'Store' AS channel, ss.ss_quantity AS quantity, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit, ss.ss_sales_price AS price, NULL AS warehouse_name FROM store_sales ss UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, 'Web' AS channel, ws.ws_quantity AS quantity, ws.ws_net_profit AS profit, ws.ws_sales_price AS price, w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) SELECT item_sk, channel, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(profit) AS total_profit, AVG(price) AS avg_price, CASE WHEN SUM(quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(profit) / SUM(quantity) END AS profit_per_unit, any_value(warehouse_name) AS sample_warehouse, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY SUM(profit) DESC) AS profit_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY SUM(profit) DESC) AS profit_percentile FROM unified_items GROUP BY item_sk, channel HAVING SUM(profit) > 0 ORDER BY channel, profit_rank LIMIT 30

WITH discount_data AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, 'Store' AS channel, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk UNION ALL SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, 'Web' AS channel, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, ws.ws_net_profit AS profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ) SELECT city, channel, AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(profit) AS avg_profit, CASE WHEN AVG(discount_amt) > 30 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN AVG(discount_amt) BETWEEN 15 AND 30 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY AVG(discount_amt) DESC) AS discount_rank FROM discount_data GROUP BY city, channel HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY channel, discount_rank LIMIT 25

WITH combined_monthly AS ( SELECT month, channel, location, SUM(profit) AS month_profit, SUM(net_paid) AS month_net_paid FROM ( SELECT date_trunc('month', date_parse(cast(ss.ss_sold_date_sk as varchar), '%Y%m%d')) AS month, ca.ca_state AS location, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit, ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid, 'Store' AS channel FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('month', date_parse(cast(ws.ws_sold_date_sk as varchar), '%Y%m%d')) AS month, w.w_city AS location, ws.ws_net_profit AS profit, ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid, 'Web' AS channel FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) sub GROUP BY month, channel, location ) SELECT month, channel, location, month_profit, month_net_paid, LAG(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, location ORDER BY month) AS prior_month_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, location ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN month_profit > LAG(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, location ORDER BY month) THEN 'Increase' WHEN month_profit < LAG(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, location ORDER BY month) THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'Flat' END AS profit_trend, SUM(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, location ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY month_profit DESC) AS month_location_rank FROM combined_monthly ORDER BY month, channel, month_location_rank LIMIT 48

WITH store_state AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state AS state, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_qty, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_amount FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state ), warehouse_state AS ( SELECT w.w_state AS state, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_profit, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_qty, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_amount, SUM(w.w_warehouse_sq_ft) AS total_sq_ft, AVG(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_state ) SELECT s.state, s.store_profit, w.web_profit, s.store_profit + w.web_profit AS combined_profit, (s.store_profit + w.web_profit) / NULLIF(w.total_sq_ft, 0) AS profit_per_sq_ft, w.avg_ship_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.store_profit + w.web_profit) DESC) AS profit_state_rank, CASE WHEN (s.store_profit + w.web_profit) > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN (s.store_profit + w.web_profit) BETWEEN 500000 AND 1000000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM store_state s JOIN warehouse_state w ON s.state = w.state WHERE w.total_sq_ft > 0 ORDER BY profit_state_rank LIMIT 15

WITH address_sales AS ( SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, ca.ca_city AS city, ca.ca_state AS state, ca.ca_country AS country, ss.ss_ticket_number AS trans_id, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit, 'Store' AS channel, NULL AS warehouse_city FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk UNION ALL SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, ca.ca_city AS city, ca.ca_state AS state, ca.ca_country AS country, ws.ws_order_number AS trans_id, ws.ws_net_profit AS profit, 'Web' AS channel, w.w_city AS warehouse_city FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) SELECT address_sk, city, state, country, channel, warehouse_city, AVG(profit) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt, CASE WHEN AVG(profit) > 5000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN AVG(profit) > 2000 THEN 'High' WHEN AVG(profit) > 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY AVG(profit) DESC) AS rn FROM address_sales GROUP BY address_sk, city, state, country, channel, warehouse_city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY channel, rn LIMIT 10

WITH promo_returns AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN sr.sr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS female_return_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'M' THEN sr.sr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS male_return_amount FROM promotion p JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost ) SELECT p_promo_id, p_promo_name, p_cost, total_return_amount, total_returns, female_return_amount, male_return_amount, CASE WHEN p_cost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE total_return_amount / p_cost END AS return_to_cost_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN p_cost = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_return_amount / p_cost END DESC) AS cost_effectiveness_rank FROM promo_returns WHERE total_returns > 0 ORDER BY cost_effectiveness_rank LIMIT 15

WITH demo_returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN i.i_current_price > 100 THEN sr.sr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS high_price_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_marital_status ) SELECT cd_credit_rating, cd_marital_status, total_net_loss, avg_return_amount, return_cnt, high_price_return_amt, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'Very High Loss' WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_bucket, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loss FROM demo_returns ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 30

WITH item_return_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_current_price, i.i_wholesale_cost, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_transactions, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_discounted_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_credit_rating) AS distinct_credit_ratings FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_current_price, i.i_wholesale_cost ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, total_return_qty, return_transactions, avg_return_amount, promo_discounted_returns, distinct_credit_ratings, CASE WHEN i_current_price < 20 AND total_return_qty > 100 THEN 'Flagged' ELSE 'Normal' END AS item_flag, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS return_qty_quintile, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(total_return_qty AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(i_current_price, 0) DESC) AS qty_price_ratio_rank FROM item_return_stats WHERE total_return_qty > 0 ORDER BY qty_price_ratio_rank LIMIT 25

WITH category_loss AS ( SELECT i.i_category, i.i_item_id, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_count, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN sr.sr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_return_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_credit_rating) AS distinct_credit_ratings FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_item_id ) SELECT i_category, i_item_id, total_net_loss, return_count, avg_return_amount, discounted_return_amt, distinct_credit_ratings, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > (SELECT AVG(total_net_loss) FROM category_loss) THEN 'High Loss' ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM category_loss ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH store_promo_loss AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_promo_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Excellent' THEN sr.sr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS excellent_credit_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost ) SELECT sr_store_sk, p_promo_id, p_promo_name, p_cost, store_promo_net_loss, return_cnt, excellent_credit_loss, CASE WHEN store_promo_net_loss > (SELECT AVG(store_promo_net_loss) FROM store_promo_loss) THEN 'Above Avg Loss' ELSE 'Below Avg Loss' END AS loss_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk ORDER BY store_promo_net_loss DESC) AS store_promo_rank, SUM(store_promo_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk) AS total_store_loss, ROUND(100.0 * store_promo_net_loss / NULLIF(SUM(store_promo_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk),0),2) AS loss_percentage_of_store FROM store_promo_loss WHERE return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY sr_store_sk, store_promo_rank LIMIT 50

WITH returns_with_time AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, td.t_hour, td.t_minute, sm.sm_type, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_order_number FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk ) SELECT rwt.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, rwt.w_warehouse_name, rwt.sm_type, rwt.t_hour, rwt.t_minute, rwt.cr_net_loss, SUM(rwt.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY rwt.w_warehouse_name, rwt.sm_type ORDER BY rwt.cr_returned_date_sk, rwt.t_hour, rwt.t_minute ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, CASE WHEN rwt.cr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'LOSS' WHEN rwt.cr_net_loss < 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'NEUTRAL' END AS net_loss_flag FROM returns_with_time rwt WHERE rwt.cr_net_loss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rwt.w_warehouse_name, rwt.sm_type, rwt.cr_returned_date_sk, rwt.t_hour, rwt.t_minute

SELECT cr.cr_order_number, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, w.w_city, cr.cr_return_tax, at.avg_tax, CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_tax > at.avg_tax THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_TAX' ELSE 'NORMAL_TAX' END AS tax_flag, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY cr.cr_return_tax DESC) AS tax_rank_within_ship_mode FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ( SELECT cr.cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk, td.t_meal_time AS meal_time, AVG(cr.cr_return_tax) AS avg_tax FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, td.t_meal_time ) at ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = at.ship_mode_sk AND td.t_meal_time = at.meal_time WHERE cr.cr_return_tax IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sm.sm_type, tax_rank_within_ship_mode LIMIT 100

SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0), 0) AS refund_to_return_ratio, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0), 0) > 0.8 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0), 0) > 0.5 THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'POOR' END AS performance_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0), 0) DESC) AS ratio_rank FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 0 ORDER BY ratio_rank

SELECT sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, w.w_state, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, CASE WHEN AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) >= 5 THEN 'BULK' WHEN AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) >= 2 THEN 'MULTI' ELSE 'SINGLE' END AS quantity_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.t_meal_time ORDER BY AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, w.w_state HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY td.t_meal_time, rank_by_amount

WITH daily_warehouse_ship AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, td.t_meal_time, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time ) SELECT return_date, w_warehouse_name, ship_mode_type, t_meal_time, total_net_loss, return_cnt, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY return_date ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS warehouse_shipmode_rank FROM daily_warehouse_ship WHERE total_net_loss > 0 ORDER BY return_date, warehouse_shipmode_rank

WITH customer_refunds AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, COUNT(*) AS total_returns FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ), customer_ranked AS ( SELECT customer_sk, total_refunded_cash, total_returns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_refunded_cash DESC) AS rn FROM customer_refunds ), customer_ship_mode AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, sm.sm_type, COUNT(*) AS ship_mode_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, sm.sm_type ), customer_ship_mode_ranked AS ( SELECT customer_sk, sm_type, ship_mode_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY ship_mode_cnt DESC) AS rn_mode FROM customer_ship_mode ), customer_warehouse AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, COUNT(*) AS wh_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, w.w_warehouse_name ), customer_warehouse_ranked AS ( SELECT customer_sk, w_warehouse_name, wh_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY wh_cnt DESC) AS rn_wh FROM customer_warehouse ), customer_avg_hour AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, AVG(td.t_hour) AS avg_return_hour FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ) SELECT crk.customer_sk, crk.total_refunded_cash, crk.total_returns, csm.sm_type AS most_common_ship_mode, csm.ship_mode_cnt AS ship_mode_occurrences, cwh.w_warehouse_name AS most_common_warehouse, cwh.wh_cnt AS warehouse_occurrences, ROUND(cah.avg_return_hour, 2) AS avg_return_hour FROM customer_ranked crk JOIN customer_ship_mode_ranked csm ON crk.customer_sk = csm.customer_sk AND csm.rn_mode = 1 JOIN customer_warehouse_ranked cwh ON crk.customer_sk = cwh.customer_sk AND cwh.rn_wh = 1 JOIN customer_avg_hour cah ON crk.customer_sk = cah.customer_sk WHERE crk.rn <= 5 ORDER BY crk.total_refunded_cash DESC

WITH daily_activity AS (SELECT d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(wp.wp_char_count) AS total_chars, SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_images, SUM(wp.wp_char_count + wp.wp_image_count * 100) AS activity_score FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq) SELECT da.d_date, da.d_year, da.d_month_seq, da.total_chars, da.total_images, da.activity_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY da.activity_score DESC) AS activity_rank, CASE WHEN da.activity_score > 100000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN da.activity_score > 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN da.activity_score > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS activity_category FROM daily_activity da WHERE da.activity_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY activity_rank LIMIT 5

WITH monthly_emp AS (SELECT s.s_division_id, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, AVG(s.s_number_employees) AS avg_employees, SUM(s.s_floor_space) AS total_floor_space FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY s.s_division_id, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq) SELECT me.s_division_id, me.d_year, me.d_month_seq, me.avg_employees, me.total_floor_space, LAG(me.avg_employees) OVER (PARTITION BY me.s_division_id ORDER BY me.d_year, me.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_avg_emp, CASE WHEN LAG(me.avg_employees) OVER (PARTITION BY me.s_division_id ORDER BY me.d_year, me.d_month_seq) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((me.avg_employees - LAG(me.avg_employees) OVER (PARTITION BY me.s_division_id ORDER BY me.d_year, me.d_month_seq)) / LAG(me.avg_employees) OVER (PARTITION BY me.s_division_id ORDER BY me.d_year, me.d_month_seq) * 100, 2) END AS pct_change_emp FROM monthly_emp me WHERE me.avg_employees IS NOT NULL ORDER BY me.s_division_id, me.d_year, me.d_month_seq LIMIT 200

WITH store_info AS (SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, s.s_city, s.s_number_employees, s.s_floor_space, s.s_rec_start_date, s.s_tax_percentage, d_closure.d_date AS closure_date FROM store s LEFT JOIN date_dim d_closure ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closure.d_date_sk) SELECT si.s_store_id, si.s_store_name, si.s_state, si.s_city, si.s_number_employees, si.s_floor_space, si.s_rec_start_date, si.closure_date, CASE WHEN si.closure_date IS NULL THEN date_diff('day', si.s_rec_start_date, current_date) ELSE date_diff('day', si.s_rec_start_date, si.closure_date) END AS days_operational, CASE WHEN si.s_tax_percentage > 0.10 THEN 'High Tax' ELSE 'Standard Tax' END AS tax_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY si.s_state ORDER BY si.s_floor_space DESC) AS floor_space_state_rank FROM store_info si WHERE si.s_number_employees > 0 ORDER BY si.s_state, floor_space_state_rank LIMIT 100

WITH site_pages AS (SELECT ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_tax_percentage, wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_char_count, wp.wp_image_count, d_creation.d_date AS page_creation_date, d_open.d_date AS site_open_date, d_close.d_date AS site_close_date FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk CROSS JOIN web_page wp JOIN date_dim d_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_creation.d_date_sk WHERE d_creation.d_date >= d_open.d_date AND (d_close.d_date IS NULL OR d_creation.d_date < d_close.d_date)) SELECT sp.web_site_id, sp.web_name, sp.web_mkt_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created, SUM(sp.wp_char_count) AS total_chars, SUM(sp.wp_image_count) AS total_images, CASE WHEN sp.web_tax_percentage > 0.08 THEN 'High Tax' ELSE 'Standard Tax' END AS tax_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.web_mkt_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sp.wp_web_page_sk) DESC) AS market_site_rank FROM site_pages sp GROUP BY sp.web_site_id, sp.web_name, sp.web_mkt_id, sp.web_tax_percentage ORDER BY sp.web_mkt_id, market_site_rank LIMIT 20

WITH daily_agg AS (SELECT d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_sk) AS stores_closed, COALESCE(SUM(s.s_floor_space),0) AS floor_space_closed, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.web_site_sk) AS sites_opened, COALESCE(SUM(ws.web_tax_percentage),0) AS tax_opened, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created, COALESCE(SUM(wp.wp_char_count),0) AS chars_created FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend) SELECT da.d_date, da.d_year, da.d_month_seq, da.d_day_name, da.stores_closed, da.floor_space_closed, da.sites_opened, da.tax_opened, da.pages_created, da.chars_created, (da.floor_space_closed * 0.5 + da.tax_opened * 100 + da.chars_created / 1000.0) AS combined_metric, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (da.floor_space_closed * 0.5 + da.tax_opened * 100 + da.chars_created / 1000.0) DESC) AS metric_rank, CASE WHEN da.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, SUM(da.floor_space_closed) OVER (PARTITION BY da.d_year ORDER BY da.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_floor_space_year, SUM(da.tax_opened) OVER (PARTITION BY da.d_year ORDER BY da.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_tax_year FROM daily_agg da ORDER BY da.d_date DESC LIMIT 100

WITH store_closures AS (SELECT d.d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_sk) AS stores_closed, COALESCE(SUM(s.s_floor_space),0) AS floor_space_closed FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), page_creations AS (SELECT d.d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created, COALESCE(SUM(wp.wp_char_count),0) AS total_chars, COALESCE(SUM(wp.wp_image_count),0) AS total_images FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), site_openings AS (SELECT d.d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.web_site_sk) AS sites_opened, COALESCE(SUM(ws.web_tax_percentage),0) AS total_tax_percentage FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date) SELECT sc.d_date, sc.stores_closed, sc.floor_space_closed, so.sites_opened, so.total_tax_percentage, pc.pages_created, pc.total_chars, pc.total_images, CASE WHEN sc.stores_closed = 0 THEN NULL ELSE pc.pages_created * 1.0 / sc.stores_closed END AS pages_per_store_closed, CASE WHEN so.sites_opened = 0 THEN NULL ELSE pc.pages_created * 1.0 / so.sites_opened END AS pages_per_site_opened, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pc.pages_created DESC) AS page_creation_rank, LAG(pc.pages_created) OVER (ORDER BY sc.d_date) AS prev_day_pages_created, CASE WHEN LAG(pc.pages_created) OVER (ORDER BY sc.d_date) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pc.pages_created - LAG(pc.pages_created) OVER (ORDER BY sc.d_date) END AS day_page_delta FROM store_closures sc LEFT JOIN page_creations pc ON sc.d_date = pc.d_date LEFT JOIN site_openings so ON sc.d_date = so.d_date WHERE (sc.stores_closed > 0 OR pc.pages_created > 0 OR so.sites_opened > 0) ORDER BY sc.d_date DESC LIMIT 30

WITH cs_filtered AS (SELECT cs.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_call_center_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS rn FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231) SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cf.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(cf.cs_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY cf.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_net_paid, SUM(cf.cs_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY cf.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_quantity, LAG(cf.cs_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY cf.cs_sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_net_paid, CASE WHEN cf.cs_net_paid > COALESCE(LAG(cf.cs_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY cf.cs_sold_date_sk),0) THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'DecreaseOrSame' END AS net_paid_trend FROM cs_filtered cf JOIN call_center cc ON cf.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk WHERE cf.rn <= 30 ORDER BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cf.cs_sold_date_sk

WITH cc_sales AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 0) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, avg_net_profit, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_paid > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS revenue_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM cc_sales ORDER BY revenue_rank

WITH ship_addr_sales AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk >= 20220101 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) >= 10) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, total_quantity, total_discount, avg_discount, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 50 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN avg_discount > 20 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS ship_addr_quantity_rank FROM ship_addr_sales ORDER BY cc_call_center_sk, ship_addr_quantity_rank

WITH address_sales_returns AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid,0)) AS total_sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt,0)) AS total_returns, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss,0)) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS sales_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS return_orders FROM customer_address ca LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States' GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state HAVING SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity,0)) > 0) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, total_sales, total_returns, total_sales - total_returns AS net_sales_after_returns, CASE WHEN total_returns / NULLIF(total_sales,0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Return Rate' WHEN total_returns / NULLIF(total_sales,0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Return Rate' ELSE 'Low Return Rate' END AS return_rate_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM address_sales_returns ORDER BY loss_rank

WITH order_returns AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_addr_sk, cs.cs_quantity AS sold_qty, COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity,0) AS returned_qty FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231) SELECT o.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(o.sold_qty) AS total_sold_qty, SUM(o.returned_qty) AS total_returned_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(o.sold_qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(o.returned_qty) / SUM(o.sold_qty) END AS return_rate, CASE WHEN SUM(o.returned_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(o.sold_qty),0) > 0.3 THEN 'High Return Rate' WHEN SUM(o.returned_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(o.sold_qty),0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Return Rate' ELSE 'Low Return Rate' END AS return_rate_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.returned_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(o.sold_qty),0) DESC) AS return_rate_rank FROM order_returns o JOIN customer_address ca ON o.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY o.cs_bill_customer_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state HAVING SUM(o.sold_qty) >= 5 ORDER BY return_rate_rank LIMIT 50

WITH address_sales_returns AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid,0)) AS total_sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt,0)) AS total_returns, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss,0)) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM customer_address ca LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States' GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, total_sales, total_returns, total_sales - total_returns AS net_sales, total_net_loss, total_records, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss) AS net_loss_percentile FROM address_sales_returns WHERE total_sales BETWEEN 500 AND 5000 ORDER BY net_loss_percentile

WITH address_sales_returns AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid,0)) AS total_sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt,0)) AS total_returns, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss,0)) AS total_net_loss FROM customer_address ca LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('NY','TX','FL') GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, total_sales, total_returns, total_sales - total_returns AS net_sales, total_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS profit_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS state_loss_rank FROM address_sales_returns ORDER BY ca_state, state_loss_rank

WITH address_sales_returns AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid,0)) AS total_sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt,0)) AS total_returns, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss,0)) AS total_net_loss FROM customer_address ca LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_city LIKE 'San%' GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, total_sales, total_returns, total_sales - total_returns AS net_sales, total_net_loss, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_quartile FROM address_sales_returns WHERE total_sales > 1000 ORDER BY loss_quartile, net_sales DESC

WITH address_sales_returns AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid,0)) AS total_sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt,0)) AS total_returns, SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss,0)) AS total_net_loss FROM customer_address ca LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States' GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, total_sales, total_returns, total_sales - total_returns AS net_sales, total_net_loss, total_sales / NULLIF(total_returns,0) AS sales_to_return_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM address_sales_returns WHERE total_returns > 0 AND total_sales > 0 ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 20

WITH order_returns AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity AS sold_qty,
           COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0) AS returned_qty,
           cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231
)
SELECT o.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
       ca.ca_city,
       ca.ca_state,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_count,
       SUM(o.sold_qty) AS total_sold_qty,
       SUM(o.returned_qty) AS total_returned_qty,
       ROUND(AVG(o.net_paid), 2) AS avg_net_paid,
       CASE WHEN SUM(o.returned_qty) > 0 THEN 'Has Returns' ELSE 'No Returns' END AS return_flag
FROM order_returns o
JOIN customer_address ca ON o.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY o.cs_bill_customer_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY orders_count DESC

WITH order_returns AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity AS sold_qty,
           COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0) AS returned_qty,
           cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid_inc_tax,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231
)
SELECT o.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
       ca.ca_city,
       ca.ca_state,
       SUM(o.sold_qty) AS total_sold_qty,
       SUM(o.returned_qty) AS total_returned_qty,
       SUM(o.net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.returned_qty) DESC) AS return_quantity_percentile,
       CASE WHEN SUM(o.returned_qty) > 0 THEN 'Returned' ELSE 'No Return' END AS return_indicator
FROM order_returns o
JOIN customer_address ca ON o.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY o.cs_bill_customer_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state
HAVING SUM(o.sold_qty) >= 5
ORDER BY return_quantity_percentile DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH order_returns AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity AS sold_qty,
           COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0) AS returned_qty,
           date_parse(CAST(cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS sold_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231
)
SELECT o.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
       ca.ca_state,
       EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.sold_date) AS month,
       SUM(o.sold_qty) AS total_sold_qty,
       SUM(o.returned_qty) AS total_returned_qty,
       ROUND(SUM(o.returned_qty) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.sold_qty), 0), 2) AS return_percent,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY SUM(o.returned_qty) DESC) AS state_rank
FROM order_returns o
JOIN customer_address ca ON o.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY o.cs_bill_customer_sk, ca.ca_state, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.sold_date)
HAVING SUM(o.sold_qty) >= 3
ORDER BY ca.ca_state, month

WITH order_returns AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity AS sold_qty,
           COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0) AS returned_qty,
           cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231
)
SELECT o.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
       ca.ca_city,
       ca.ca_state,
       sm.cs_ship_mode_sk,
       SUM(o.sold_qty) AS total_sold_qty,
       SUM(o.returned_qty) AS total_returned_qty,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.returned_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(o.sold_qty), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(o.cs_sold_date_sk) AS last_sold_date_sk
FROM order_returns o
JOIN customer_address ca ON o.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_mode_sk FROM catalog_sales) sm ON o.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.cs_ship_mode_sk
GROUP BY o.cs_bill_customer_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, sm.cs_ship_mode_sk
HAVING SUM(o.sold_qty) >= 6
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    latest_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AS latest_sale_date,
    latest_sales.ss_ext_sales_price AS sale_price,
    CASE WHEN latest_sales.ss_ext_sales_price = 0 THEN NULL ELSE latest_sales.ss_ext_discount_amt / latest_sales.ss_ext_sales_price END AS discount_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN latest_sales.ss_ext_sales_price = 0 THEN 'UNKNOWN'
        WHEN latest_sales.ss_ext_discount_amt / latest_sales.ss_ext_sales_price > 0.2 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN latest_sales.ss_ext_discount_amt / latest_sales.ss_ext_sales_price > 0.1 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS discount_category,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'NO_PROMO') AS promotion_name,
    COALESCE(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS current_inventory_qty
FROM (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_sales ss
) latest_sales
JOIN item i ON latest_sales.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON latest_sales.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
WHERE latest_sales.rn = 1
ORDER BY discount_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

WITH brand_warehouse_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        MAX(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_promotion_flag
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_brand, inv.inv_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    i_brand,
    warehouse_id,
    total_profit,
    total_sales,
    CASE WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(total_profit / total_sales * 100, 2) END AS profit_margin_percent,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS warehouse_profit_rank,
    has_promotion_flag
FROM brand_warehouse_agg
ORDER BY i_brand, total_profit DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH item_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_units_sold,
        MAX(p.p_discount_active) AS any_discount_active_flag
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category
    HAVING SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) > 0
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    i_category,
    total_inventory,
    total_units_sold,
    CASE WHEN total_units_sold = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(total_inventory AS DOUBLE) / total_units_sold END AS inventory_to_sales_ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC) AS category_sales_rank,
    any_discount_active_flag
FROM item_agg
ORDER BY inventory_to_sales_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

WITH item_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_revenue,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS promo_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    total_sales_revenue,
    total_units_sold,
    total_inventory_on_hand,
    promo_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_revenue DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM item_sales_agg
ORDER BY total_sales_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS promo_sales_revenue,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_given,
        p.p_cost,
        COALESCE(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS promo_inventory_stock
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, p.p_cost
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 0
)
SELECT
    p_promo_id,
    p_promo_name,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    promo_sales_revenue,
    total_discount_given,
    p_cost,
    CASE WHEN p_cost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (promo_sales_revenue - total_discount_given) / p_cost END AS roi,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN p_cost = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (promo_sales_revenue - total_discount_given) / p_cost END DESC) AS roi_rank,
    promo_inventory_stock
FROM promo_agg
ORDER BY roi DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS daily_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    ds.ss_sold_date_sk,
    ds.daily_quantity,
    LAG(ds.daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ss_item_sk ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk) AS prev_daily_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(ds.daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ss_item_sk ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN ds.daily_quantity > LAG(ds.daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ss_item_sk ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk) THEN 'INCREASE'
        ELSE 'NO_INCREASE'
    END AS sales_trend_flag,
    CASE
        WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL AND ds.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk THEN 'PROMO_ACTIVE'
        ELSE 'NO_PROMO'
    END AS promo_status,
    COALESCE(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS inventory_on_hand
FROM daily_sales ds
JOIN item i ON ds.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON i.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
WHERE ds.daily_quantity > 0
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, ds.ss_sold_date_sk
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_qty AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
web_qty AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT sold_date, total_quantity, 'catalog' AS channel FROM catalog_qty
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sold_date, total_quantity, 'web' AS channel FROM web_qty
)
SELECT
    sold_date,
    channel,
    total_quantity,
    moving_avg_3d,
    CASE
        WHEN moving_avg_3d >= 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN moving_avg_3d >= 500 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS moving_avg_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        sold_date,
        channel,
        total_quantity,
        AVG(total_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY sold_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3d
    FROM combined
) t
ORDER BY sold_date, channel

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        ca_city,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_state, ca_city
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    avg_discount,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount DESC) AS discount_rank,
    SUM(avg_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY avg_discount ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_avg_discount_state
FROM agg
ORDER BY discount_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_ship AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state AS ship_state,
        cs.cs_ext_ship_cost AS ship_cost,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
web_ship AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state AS ship_state,
        ws.ws_ext_ship_cost AS ship_cost,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT ship_state, ship_cost, net_profit FROM catalog_ship
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ship_state, ship_cost, net_profit FROM web_ship
),
state_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ship_state,
