        SUM(ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost,
        SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ship_state
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ship_cost_per_profit DESC) AS shipping_ratio_rank,
    ship_state,
    total_ship_cost,
    total_net_profit,
    ship_cost_per_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_ship_cost > 50000 THEN 'Expensive'
        WHEN total_ship_cost > 20000 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Cheap'
    END AS shipping_category
FROM (
    SELECT
        ship_state,
        total_ship_cost,
        total_net_profit,
        CAST(total_ship_cost AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_net_profit, 0) AS ship_cost_per_profit
    FROM state_agg
) s
ORDER BY shipping_ratio_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH catalog AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state AS bill_state,
        (cs.cs_net_paid + cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_paid_total
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
web AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state AS bill_state,
        (ws.ws_net_paid + ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_paid_total
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT bill_state, net_paid_total FROM catalog
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bill_state, net_paid_total FROM web
),
state_agg AS (
    SELECT
        bill_state,
        SUM(net_paid_total) AS total_net_paid
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY bill_state
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS state_rank,
    bill_state,
    total_net_paid,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_paid >= 200000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_net_paid >= 100000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS payment_category
FROM state_agg
ORDER BY state_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH catalog_sales_addr AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk AS bill_addr_sk,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
web_sales_addr AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_addr_sk AS bill_addr_sk,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT bill_addr_sk, ca_state, ca_city, sold_date, net_profit FROM catalog_sales_addr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bill_addr_sk, ca_state, ca_city, sold_date, net_profit FROM web_sales_addr
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT
        bill_addr_sk,
        ca_state,
        ca_city,
        sold_date,
        net_profit,
        SUM(net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY bill_addr_sk ORDER BY sold_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit
    FROM combined
)
SELECT
    bill_addr_sk,
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    MAX(sold_date) AS last_sold_date,
    MAX(cumulative_profit) AS total_cumulative_profit,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(cumulative_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(cumulative_profit) >= 500000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN MAX(cumulative_profit) >= 200000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN MAX(cumulative_profit) >= 50000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS customer_tier
FROM ordered
GROUP BY bill_addr_sk, ca_state, ca_city
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_profit AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs.cs_net_profit / NULLIF(cs.cs_quantity, 0) AS profit_per_unit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
web_profit AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ws.ws_quantity AS quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_profit / NULLIF(ws.ws_quantity, 0) AS profit_per_unit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT ca_state, quantity, net_profit, profit_per_unit, 'catalog' AS channel FROM catalog_profit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca_state, quantity, net_profit, profit_per_unit, 'web' AS channel FROM web_profit
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        channel,
        AVG(profit_per_unit) AS avg_profit_per_unit,
        SUM(profit_per_unit) AS total_profit_per_unit
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_state, channel
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    channel,
    avg_profit_per_unit,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY avg_profit_per_unit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_profit_per_unit >= 100 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN avg_profit_per_unit >= 50 THEN 'High'
        WHEN avg_profit_per_unit >= 20 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM agg
ORDER BY channel, profit_rank
LIMIT 50

WITH ticket_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk,
         ss_ticket_number,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS sales_amount
  FROM store_sales ss
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_ticket_number
),
 ticket_returns AS (
  SELECT sr_store_sk,
         sr_ticket_number,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS returns_amount
  FROM store_returns sr
  GROUP BY sr_store_sk, sr_ticket_number
)
SELECT s.s_store_id,
       ts.ss_ticket_number,
       ts.sales_amount,
       COALESCE(tr.returns_amount, 0) AS returns_amount,
       ts.sales_amount - COALESCE(tr.returns_amount, 0) AS net_ticket_revenue,
       CASE 
         WHEN ts.sales_amount - COALESCE(tr.returns_amount, 0) < 0 THEN 'Negative Revenue'
         ELSE 'Positive Revenue'
       END AS revenue_flag,
       SUM(ts.sales_amount - COALESCE(tr.returns_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk ORDER BY ts.ss_ticket_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_store_revenue
FROM store s
JOIN ticket_sales ts ON s.s_store_sk = ts.ss_store_sk
LEFT JOIN ticket_returns tr
  ON s.s_store_sk = tr.sr_store_sk
 AND ts.ss_ticket_number = tr.sr_ticket_number
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, ts.ss_ticket_number

SELECT s.s_store_id,
       r.r_reason_desc,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
       CASE
         WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High Impact'
         WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Medium Impact'
         ELSE 'Low Impact'
       END AS impact_level,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank_per_store
FROM store s
JOIN store_returns sr ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc
HAVING SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 0
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, loss_rank_per_store

WITH manager_sales AS (
  SELECT s.s_manager AS manager,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
  FROM store s
  JOIN store_sales ss ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
  GROUP BY s.s_manager
),
 manager_returns AS (
  SELECT s.s_manager AS manager,
         SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_loss
  FROM store s
  JOIN store_returns sr ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
  GROUP BY s.s_manager
)
SELECT ms.manager,
       ms.total_profit,
       COALESCE(mr.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
       CASE 
         WHEN (ms.total_profit + COALESCE(mr.total_loss, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE ms.total_profit / (ms.total_profit + COALESCE(mr.total_loss, 0))
       END AS profit_margin,
       CASE 
         WHEN (ms.total_profit / (ms.total_profit + COALESCE(mr.total_loss, 0))) >= 0.75 THEN 'Excellent'
         WHEN (ms.total_profit / (ms.total_profit + COALESCE(mr.total_loss, 0))) >= 0.5 THEN 'Good'
         ELSE 'Poor'
       END AS performance_category,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 
         CASE 
           WHEN (ms.total_profit + COALESCE(mr.total_loss, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE ms.total_profit / (ms.total_profit + COALESCE(mr.total_loss, 0))
         END DESC) AS manager_rank
FROM manager_sales ms
LEFT JOIN manager_returns mr ON ms.manager = mr.manager
ORDER BY manager_rank

WITH sales_agg AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit
  FROM store_sales
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
  SELECT sr_store_sk, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
  FROM store_returns
  GROUP BY sr_store_sk
)
SELECT s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       COALESCE(sa.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_contribution,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM store s
LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON s.s_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra ON s.s_store_sk = ra.sr_store_sk
WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY net_contribution DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.s_store_id,
       ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
       SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
       COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty,
       CASE 
         WHEN SUM(ss.ss_quantity) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) * 100.0 / SUM(ss.ss_quantity)
       END AS return_rate_pct,
       CASE 
         WHEN COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_quantity), 0) > 0.30 THEN 'Potential Issue'
         ELSE 'Normal'
       END AS issue_flag,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk ORDER BY 
         CASE 
           WHEN SUM(ss.ss_quantity) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) * 1.0 / SUM(ss.ss_quantity)
         END DESC) AS return_rate_rank
FROM store s
JOIN store_sales ss ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr 
  ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk 
 AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) > 0
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, return_rate_rank

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid > 1000
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax < 500
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        ca_city,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        MAX(discount_amt) AS max_discount
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_state, ca_city
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    cnt,
    max_discount,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY max_discount DESC) AS discount_rank,
    SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS total_cnt_state
FROM agg
WHERE cnt >= 2
ORDER BY discount_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax > 200
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_char_count BETWEEN 5000 AND 20000
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        ca_city,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
        SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_state, ca_city
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    txn_cnt,
    total_net_paid,
    avg_discount,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_cume_dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY avg_discount ASC) AS discount_rank_within_state
FROM agg
WHERE txn_cnt >= 3
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 30

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_quantity AS qty,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_quantity AS qty,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_link_count < 10
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        ca_city,
        SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        MAX(time_sk) AS latest_time_sk
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_state, ca_city
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    total_qty,
    avg_discount,
    latest_time_sk,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS qty_percentile,
    SUM(total_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY avg_discount ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_qty_by_state
FROM agg
ORDER BY qty_percentile DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_profit BETWEEN 0 AND 500
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_image_count > 3
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        ca_city,
        SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_state, ca_city
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    total_profit,
    avg_discount,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_quartile,
    SUM(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS state_total_profit
FROM agg
WHERE total_profit > 0
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 25

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_quantity AS qty
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 5
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_quantity AS qty
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE wp.wp_type = 'article'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        ca_city,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(qty) AS total_qty
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_state, ca_city
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    avg_discount,
    total_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY avg_discount DESC) AS state_rank,
    SUM(total_qty) OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_qty
FROM agg
ORDER BY avg_discount DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT w.w_city, sm.sm_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE sm.sm_type LIKE 'AIR%' GROUP BY w.w_city, sm.sm_type HAVING COUNT(cr.cr_order_number) > 50 ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC

SELECT w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) DESC) AS cash_percentile FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 0 GROUP BY w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time ORDER BY cash_percentile ASC

SELECT w.w_state, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_shift, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) - SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS cash_vs_return_diff FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE w.w_country = 'United States' AND cr.cr_return_quantity >= 5 GROUP BY w.w_state, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_shift HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 1000 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC

SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, (SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) - SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)) AS cash_return_diff, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) - SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 5000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) - SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 0 AND 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS diff_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000 ORDER BY cash_return_diff DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0), 0) AS refund_to_return_ratio, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0), 0) > 0.9 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0), 0) > 0.6 THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'POOR' END AS performance_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 0 AND td.t_meal_time IN ('BREAKFAST','LUNCH') GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time ORDER BY refund_to_return_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_sk) AS distinct_promos, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, AVG(CASE WHEN wp.wp_image_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE wp.wp_image_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(wp.wp_link_count, 0) END) AS avg_image_link_ratio FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name ) SELECT ps.wp_web_page_sk, ps.wp_url, ps.wp_type, ps.web_name, ps.distinct_promos, ps.total_net_profit, ps.total_quantity, ps.total_discount, ps.avg_sales_price, CASE WHEN ps.avg_image_link_ratio > 2 THEN 'Image Rich' WHEN ps.avg_image_link_ratio BETWEEN 0.5 AND 2 THEN 'Balanced' ELSE 'Link Rich' END AS page_content_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.web_name ORDER BY ps.total_net_profit DESC) AS site_page_profit_rank FROM page_sales ps WHERE ps.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ps.total_net_profit DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

WITH customer_purchases AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_net_profit, p.p_discount_active, wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name FROM web_sales ws LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk ), ranked_purchases AS ( SELECT cp.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.customer_sk ORDER BY cp.sold_date_sk) AS purchase_seq, LAG(cp.ws_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.customer_sk ORDER BY cp.sold_date_sk) AS prior_net_profit, LEAD(cp.ws_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.customer_sk ORDER BY cp.sold_date_sk) AS next_net_profit FROM customer_purchases cp ), customer_agg AS ( SELECT rp.customer_sk, COUNT(*) AS total_purchases, SUM(rp.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(rp.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN rp.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_discount_purchases, MAX(rp.ws_net_profit) AS max_profit, MIN(rp.ws_net_profit) AS min_profit FROM ranked_purchases rp GROUP BY rp.customer_sk ) SELECT ca.customer_sk, ca.total_purchases, ca.total_net_profit, ca.avg_net_profit, ca.active_discount_purchases, ca.max_profit, ca.min_profit, CASE WHEN ca.total_net_profit > 50000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN ca.total_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN ca.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_segment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM customer_agg ca WHERE ca.total_purchases >= 5 ORDER BY profit_rank FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH page_discount_metrics AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_sk) FILTER (WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y') AS active_discount_promos, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_sk) AS total_promos FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name ) SELECT pdm.web_name, pdm.wp_url, pdm.total_quantity, pdm.total_sales_amount, pdm.total_discount_amount, CASE WHEN pdm.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pdm.total_discount_amount / pdm.total_sales_amount END AS discount_rate, pdm.active_discount_promos, pdm.total_promos, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pdm.web_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN pdm.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pdm.total_discount_amount / pdm.total_sales_amount END DESC) AS discount_rate_rank, CASE WHEN pdm.active_discount_promos >= 3 THEN 'Aggressive Discounting' WHEN pdm.active_discount_promos >= 1 THEN 'Moderate Discounting' ELSE 'No Active Discount' END AS discount_strategy_category FROM page_discount_metrics pdm WHERE pdm.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY pdm.web_name, discount_rate_rank FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amt, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages, COUNT(DISTINCT wsit.web_site_sk) AS distinct_sites FROM promotion p JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active ) SELECT ps.p_promo_sk, ps.p_promo_id, ps.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN ps.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status, ps.total_net_profit, ps.total_discount_amt, ps.total_quantity, ps.distinct_pages, ps.distinct_sites, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_net_profit DESC) AS net_profit_rank, CASE WHEN ps.total_discount_amt > 10000 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category FROM promo_sales ps ORDER BY net_profit_rank FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk, wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS daily_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) AS distinct_page_types FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name ) SELECT ds.sale_date_sk, ds.web_name, ds.p_promo_name, ds.daily_net_profit, ds.daily_quantity, ds.distinct_pages, ds.distinct_page_types, AVG(ds.daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.web_name, ds.p_promo_name ORDER BY ds.sale_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7day_net_profit, CASE WHEN ds.daily_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' WHEN ds.daily_net_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Break-even' END AS profit_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.sale_date_sk ORDER BY ds.daily_net_profit DESC) AS daily_site_profit_rank FROM daily_sales ds WHERE ds.sale_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ds.sale_date_sk DESC, ds.web_name FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

WITH promo_site_sales AS ( SELECT wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) AS distinct_page_types FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name ) SELECT ps.web_name, ps.p_promo_name, ps.total_quantity, ps.total_net_profit, ps.total_discount, ps.distinct_pages, ps.distinct_page_types, CASE WHEN ps.total_discount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ps.total_net_profit / ps.total_discount END AS profit_per_discount_ratio, CASE WHEN ps.total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'High Profit' WHEN ps.total_net_profit > 50000 THEN 'Medium Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.web_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN ps.total_discount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ps.total_net_profit / ps.total_discount END DESC) AS discount_effectiveness_rank FROM promo_site_sales ps WHERE ps.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ps.web_name, discount_effectiveness_rank FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sales_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk), daily_returns AS (SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS returns_amt FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk), daily_net AS (SELECT COALESCE(ds.date_sk, dr.date_sk) AS date_sk, COALESCE(ds.sales_net_paid, 0) - COALESCE(dr.returns_amt, 0) AS net_amount FROM daily_sales ds FULL OUTER JOIN daily_returns dr ON ds.date_sk = dr.date_sk) SELECT date_sk, net_amount, AVG(net_amount) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_7day_net, CASE WHEN net_amount > (AVG(net_amount) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 1.2) THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS net_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_amount DESC) AS net_rank FROM daily_net ORDER BY date_sk

WITH sales_demo AS (SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status), returns_demo AS (SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_returns_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk) SELECT s.cd_gender, s.cd_marital_status, s.total_sales_paid, s.avg_discount, COALESCE(r.total_returns_loss, 0) AS total_returns_loss, (s.total_sales_paid - COALESCE(r.total_returns_loss, 0)) AS net_sales_after_returns, CASE WHEN (s.total_sales_paid - COALESCE(r.total_returns_loss, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (s.total_sales_paid - COALESCE(r.total_returns_loss, 0)) > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS net_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_sales_paid - COALESCE(r.total_returns_loss, 0)) DESC) AS net_rank FROM sales_demo s LEFT JOIN returns_demo r ON s.cd_demo_sk = r.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY net_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_brand AS (SELECT i.i_brand, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand), returns_brand AS (SELECT i.i_brand, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand), brand_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(sb.i_brand, rb.i_brand) AS brand, COALESCE(sb.total_sales_qty, 0) AS total_sales_qty, COALESCE(rb.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sb.total_sales_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(rb.total_return_qty, 0) * 100.0) / COALESCE(sb.total_sales_qty, 0) END AS return_rate_pct FROM sales_brand sb FULL OUTER JOIN returns_brand rb ON sb.i_brand = rb.i_brand) SELECT brand, total_sales_qty, total_return_qty, return_rate_pct, CASE WHEN return_rate_pct < 1 THEN 'LOW' WHEN return_rate_pct < 5 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'HIGH' END AS return_rate_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_qty DESC) AS sales_qty_rank, SUM(total_return_qty) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_qty DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_qty FROM brand_stats ORDER BY sales_qty_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_ship AS (SELECT cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_ext_ship_cost FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk), returns_ship AS (SELECT cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, i.i_brand, wr.wr_return_ship_cost FROM web_returns wr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON wr.wr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) SELECT ss.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode, ss.i_brand AS brand, AVG(ss.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_sale_ship_cost, AVG(rs.wr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_return_ship_cost, CASE WHEN AVG(rs.wr_return_ship_cost) > AVG(ss.cs_ext_ship_cost) THEN 'RETURN_COST_HIGHER' ELSE 'RETURN_COST_LOWER' END AS return_cost_comparison, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.i_brand ORDER BY AVG(ss.cs_ext_ship_cost) DESC) AS brand_ship_cost_rank FROM sales_ship ss LEFT JOIN returns_ship rs ON ss.cs_ship_mode_sk = rs.cs_ship_mode_sk AND ss.i_brand = rs.i_brand GROUP BY ss.cs_ship_mode_sk, ss.i_brand ORDER BY ss.i_brand, brand_ship_cost_rank LIMIT 30

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status), returns_agg AS (SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, s.cd_gender AS bill_gender, s.cd_marital_status AS bill_marital_status, s.total_sales_qty, s.total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) > 2000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) > 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s JOIN item i ON s.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.cs_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk AND s.cd_demo_sk = r.cd_demo_sk WHERE s.total_sales_qty > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_by_cust AS (SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk,COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,MAX(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS last_purchase_date_sk,AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk),returns_by_cust AS (SELECT cust_sk,SUM(total_refunds) AS total_refunds FROM (SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk,SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_refunds FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk,SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_refunds FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk) t GROUP BY cust_sk) SELECT c.c_customer_id,c.c_first_name,c.c_last_name,c.c_birth_country,c.c_preferred_cust_flag,COALESCE(s.total_sales,0) AS total_sales,COALESCE(r.total_refunds,0) AS total_refunds,(COALESCE(s.total_sales,0)-COALESCE(r.total_refunds,0)) AS net_spent,CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales,0)-COALESCE(r.total_refunds,0))>10000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales,0)-COALESCE(r.total_refunds,0))>5000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales,0)-COALESCE(r.total_refunds,0))>2000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier,s.avg_item_price,s.last_purchase_date_sk,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales,0)-COALESCE(r.total_refunds,0)) DESC) AS spend_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN sales_by_cust s ON c.c_customer_sk=s.cust_sk LEFT JOIN returns_by_cust r ON c.c_customer_sk=r.cust_sk WHERE (COALESCE(s.total_sales,0)-COALESCE(r.total_refunds,0))>0 ORDER BY net_spent DESC LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT i.i_item_sk,i.i_item_id,i.i_product_name,i.i_category,SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_birth_country='US' THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS us_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk,i.i_item_id,i.i_product_name,i.i_category),returns_agg AS (SELECT i.i_item_sk,SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_returns FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk=i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk),ranked_items AS (SELECT s.i_item_id,s.i_product_name,s.i_category,s.total_sales,s.total_profit,s.us_sales,COALESCE(r.total_returns,0) AS total_returns,(s.total_profit-COALESCE(r.total_returns,0)) AS net_profit_after_returns,CASE WHEN s.total_sales=0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit-COALESCE(r.total_returns,0))/s.total_sales END AS profit_margin,CASE WHEN s.total_sales=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.us_sales/s.total_sales END AS us_sales_ratio,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.i_category ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.total_sales=0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit-COALESCE(r.total_returns,0))/s.total_sales END DESC) AS rank_within_category FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.i_item_sk=r.i_item_sk) SELECT i_item_id,i_product_name,i_category,total_sales,total_profit,total_returns,net_profit_after_returns,profit_margin,us_sales_ratio,rank_within_category FROM ranked_items WHERE rank_within_category<=5 ORDER BY i_category,rank_within_category

WITH sales_stats AS (SELECT i.i_brand,i.i_category,SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customer_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand,i.i_category),returns_stats AS (SELECT i.i_brand,SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_returns FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk=i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand) SELECT s.i_brand,s.i_category,s.total_sales,s.total_profit,COALESCE(r.total_returns,0) AS total_returns,(s.total_profit-COALESCE(r.total_returns,0)) AS net_profit,CASE WHEN s.total_sales=0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit-COALESCE(r.total_returns,0))/s.total_sales END AS profit_margin,s.avg_discount,s.distinct_customer_count,CASE WHEN CASE WHEN s.total_sales=0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit-COALESCE(r.total_returns,0))/s.total_sales END>0.2 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS profitability_flag,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.i_category ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.total_sales=0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit-COALESCE(r.total_returns,0))/s.total_sales END DESC) AS brand_rank_in_category FROM sales_stats s LEFT JOIN returns_stats r ON s.i_brand=r.i_brand ORDER BY s.i_category,brand_rank_in_category

WITH sales_by_combo AS (SELECT c.c_birth_country,i.i_class,SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_birth_country,i.i_class),returns_by_combo AS (SELECT c.c_birth_country,i.i_class,SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS returns_amount FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk=i.i_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_birth_country,i.i_class) SELECT s.c_birth_country,s.i_class,s.sales_amount,COALESCE(r.returns_amount,0) AS returns_amount,(s.sales_amount-COALESCE(r.returns_amount,0)) AS net_amount,CASE WHEN s.sales_amount=0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.returns_amount,0)/s.sales_amount END AS return_rate,s.avg_discount,s.sales_transactions,CASE WHEN (s.sales_amount-COALESCE(r.returns_amount,0))>5000 THEN 'Strategic' ELSE 'Normal' END AS strategic_flag,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.sales_amount-COALESCE(r.returns_amount,0)) DESC) AS net_amount_rank FROM sales_by_combo s LEFT JOIN returns_by_combo r ON s.c_birth_country=r.c_birth_country AND s.i_class=r.i_class WHERE s.sales_amount>0 ORDER BY net_amount_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT i.i_item_sk,i.i_item_id,i.i_product_name,i.i_color,i.i_size,SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_birth_country='US' THEN ss.ss_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS us_sold_qty,SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_birth_country='US' THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS us_sales_amount FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk,i.i_item_id,i.i_product_name,i.i_color,i.i_size),returns_agg AS (SELECT i.i_item_sk,SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS returned_qty,SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS return_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_birth_country='US' THEN wr.wr_return_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS us_returned_qty,SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_birth_country='US' THEN wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax ELSE 0 END) AS us_return_amount FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk=i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk),ranked_items AS (SELECT s.i_item_id,s.i_product_name,s.i_color,s.i_size,s.sold_qty,COALESCE(r.returned_qty,0) AS returned_qty,CASE WHEN s.sold_qty=0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.returned_qty,0)*1.0/s.sold_qty END AS return_rate,CASE WHEN CASE WHEN s.sold_qty=0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.returned_qty,0)*1.0/s.sold_qty END>0.1 THEN 'High Return' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_flag,CASE WHEN s.sold_qty=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.total_discount/s.sold_qty END AS avg_discount_per_unit,CASE WHEN s.sales_amount=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.total_profit/s.sales_amount END AS profit_margin,CASE WHEN s.us_sold_qty=0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.us_returned_qty,0)*1.0/s.us_sold_qty END AS us_return_rate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.sold_qty=0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.returned_qty,0)*1.0/s.sold_qty END DESC) AS rn FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.i_item_sk=r.i_item_sk WHERE s.sold_qty>0) SELECT i_item_id,i_product_name,i_color,i_size,sold_qty,returned_qty,return_rate,return_flag,avg_discount_per_unit,profit_margin,us_return_rate FROM ranked_items WHERE rn<=10 ORDER BY return_rate DESC

WITH sales_detail AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk,ss.ss_sold_date_sk,ss.ss_item_sk,SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS discount_amount,SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit_amount,SUM(ss.ss_ext_tax) AS tax_amount,SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS quantity_sold FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk,ss.ss_sold_date_sk,ss.ss_item_sk),returns_agg AS (SELECT i.i_item_sk,SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk=i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk),pref_cust AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk,ss.ss_sold_date_sk,AVG(CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag='Y' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS pct_preferred_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk=c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk,ss.ss_sold_date_sk),store_daily AS (SELECT sd.ss_store_sk,sd.ss_sold_date_sk,SUM(sd.sales_amount) AS daily_sales,SUM(sd.discount_amount) AS daily_discount,SUM(sd.profit_amount) AS daily_profit,SUM(sd.tax_amount) AS daily_tax,SUM(sd.quantity_sold) AS daily_quantity,SUM(COALESCE(r.total_return_amt,0)) AS daily_returns FROM sales_detail sd LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON sd.ss_item_sk=r.i_item_sk GROUP BY sd.ss_store_sk,sd.ss_sold_date_sk),store_ranked AS (SELECT d.*,pc.pct_preferred_customers,SUM(d.daily_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.ss_store_sk ORDER BY d.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ss_sold_date_sk ORDER BY d.daily_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_per_day FROM store_daily d LEFT JOIN pref_cust pc ON d.ss_store_sk=pc.ss_store_sk AND d.ss_sold_date_sk=pc.ss_sold_date_sk) SELECT ss_store_sk,ss_sold_date_sk,daily_sales,daily_discount,cumulative_discount,daily_profit,daily_returns,daily_tax,pct_preferred_customers,profit_rank_per_day FROM store_ranked WHERE profit_rank_per_day=1 ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk DESC,ss_store_sk

WITH address_sales AS ( SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, ca.ca_city AS city, ca.ca_state AS state, ca.ca_country AS country, ss.ss_ticket_number AS trans_id, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit, 'Store' AS channel, NULL AS warehouse_city FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk UNION ALL SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, ca.ca_city AS city, ca.ca_state AS state, ca.ca_country AS country, ws.ws_order_number AS trans_id, ws.ws_net_profit AS profit, 'Web' AS channel, w.w_city AS warehouse_city FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) SELECT address_sk, city, state, country, channel, warehouse_city, COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt, SUM(profit) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(profit) > 15000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN SUM(profit) > 8000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN SUM(profit) > 3000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS tier FROM address_sales GROUP BY address_sk, city, state, country, channel, warehouse_city ORDER BY total_profit DESC, channel LIMIT 10

WITH address_sales AS ( SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, ca.ca_city AS city, ca.ca_state AS state, ca.ca_country AS country, ss.ss_ticket_number AS trans_id, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit, 'Store' AS channel, NULL AS warehouse_city FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk UNION ALL SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, ca.ca_city AS city, ca.ca_state AS state, ca.ca_country AS country, ws.ws_order_number AS trans_id, ws.ws_net_profit AS profit, 'Web' AS channel, w.w_city AS warehouse_city FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) SELECT address_sk, city, state, country, channel, warehouse_city, SUM(profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY SUM(profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM address_sales GROUP BY address_sk, city, state, country, channel, warehouse_city HAVING SUM(profit) > 1000 ORDER BY profit_rank, channel LIMIT 8

WITH customer_losses AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ca.ca_state, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, ca.ca_state ) SELECT customer_sk, ca_state, total_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN total_net_loss > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS state_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_rank FROM customer_losses WHERE total_net_loss > 0 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 10

WITH reason_stats AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state, cr.cr_reason_sk, AVG(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, cr.cr_reason_sk ), ratio_classified AS ( SELECT ca_state, cr_reason_sk, avg_refunded_cash, avg_return_amount, avg_net_loss, return_cnt, CASE WHEN avg_return_amount = 0 THEN 'No Return Amount' WHEN avg_refunded_cash / avg_return_amount >= 0.9 THEN 'Full Refund' WHEN avg_refunded_cash / avg_return_amount >= 0.5 THEN 'Partial Refund' ELSE 'Low Refund' END AS refund_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY avg_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM reason_stats ) SELECT ca_state, cr_reason_sk, avg_refunded_cash, avg_return_amount, avg_net_loss, return_cnt, refund_category, net_loss_rank FROM ratio_classified WHERE net_loss_rank <= 3 ORDER BY ca_state, net_loss_rank

WITH state_marital_losses AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS state_marital_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, cd.cd_marital_status ) SELECT ca_state, cd_marital_status, state_marital_net_loss, avg_net_loss, return_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY state_marital_net_loss DESC) AS state_marital_rank, CASE WHEN state_marital_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN state_marital_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS risk_level FROM state_marital_losses WHERE return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY ca_state, state_marital_rank

WITH item_margins AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_current_price,
        i.i_wholesale_cost,
        (i.i_current_price - i.i_wholesale_cost) AS margin,
        CASE
            WHEN (i.i_current_price - i.i_wholesale_cost) >= 50 THEN 'High'
            WHEN (i.i_current_price - i.i_wholesale_cost) BETWEEN 20 AND 49.99 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS margin_category
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_current_price IS NOT NULL
      AND i.i_wholesale_cost IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_brand,
    i_brand_id,
    margin,
    margin_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY margin DESC) AS brand_margin_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY margin_category) AS margin_category_rank
FROM item_margins
WHERE margin_category IN ('High', 'Medium')
ORDER BY i_brand, brand_margin_rank

WITH reason_totals AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
ranked_reasons AS (
    SELECT
        sr_store_sk,
        r_reason_desc,
        total_return_amount,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS reason_rank
    FROM reason_totals
)
SELECT
    sr_store_sk,
    r_reason_desc,
    total_return_amount,
    reason_rank
FROM ranked_reasons
WHERE reason_rank <= 3
ORDER BY sr_store_sk, reason_rank

WITH shift_returns AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_shift,
        td.t_meal_time,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY td.t_shift ORDER BY sr.sr_return_time_sk) AS rn,
        LAG(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY td.t_shift ORDER BY sr.sr_return_time_sk) AS prev_return_amt
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
)
SELECT
    t_shift,
    t_meal_time,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    AVG(sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_return_amt IS NOT NULL AND sr_return_amt > prev_return_amt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS increased_vs_prev,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_return_amt IS NOT NULL AND sr_return_amt < prev_return_amt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decreased_vs_prev
FROM shift_returns
GROUP BY t_shift, t_meal_time
ORDER BY t_shift, t_meal_time

WITH daily_category_loss AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, i.i_category
)
SELECT
    return_date,
    i_category,
    total_net_loss,
    LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY return_date) AS prev_day_net_loss,
    total_net_loss - LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY return_date) AS net_loss_change,
    AVG(total_net_loss) OVER (
        PARTITION BY i_category
        ORDER BY return_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_7d
FROM daily_category_loss
ORDER BY i_category, return_date

WITH hour_category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_hour,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY td.t_hour, i.i_category
)
SELECT
    t_hour,
    i_category,
    total_return_qty,
    total_net_loss,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_hour ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS category_net_loss_rank,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY t_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss_by_hour,
    LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY t_hour) AS prev_hour_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY t_hour) IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        WHEN total_net_loss > LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY t_hour) THEN 'Increase'
        ELSE 'Decrease'
    END AS net_loss_trend
FROM hour_category_stats
ORDER BY t_hour, category_net_loss_rank

WITH hourly_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, t.t_hour, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS hourly_net_paid, COUNT(*) AS hourly_txns FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, t.t_hour ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, t_hour, hourly_net_paid, hourly_txns, AVG(hourly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_catalog_page_id ORDER BY t_hour ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS three_hour_moving_avg, CASE WHEN hourly_net_paid > AVG(hourly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_catalog_page_id ORDER BY t_hour ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS performance_flag FROM hourly_sales ORDER BY cp_catalog_page_id, t_hour

WITH page_hour_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, t.t_hour, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, t.t_hour ) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_id, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_type, t_hour, total_net_paid, total_profit, total_discount, txn_count, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_paid > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS revenue_bucket, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS dept_page_rank FROM page_hour_sales WHERE t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 20 ORDER BY cp_department, dept_page_rank

WITH unified_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk, t.t_hour AS hour, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, 'Catalog' AS sales_channel FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk, t.t_hour AS hour, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit, 'Store' AS sales_channel FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk ), hourly_agg AS ( SELECT sale_date_sk, hour, sales_channel, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM unified_sales GROUP BY sale_date_sk, hour, sales_channel ) SELECT sale_date_sk, hour, sales_channel, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sale_date_sk ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS hour_rank_by_sales, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 50000 THEN 'Peak' ELSE 'Off-Peak' END AS sales_intensity FROM hourly_agg ORDER BY sale_date_sk, hour_rank_by_sales

WITH promo_agg AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, 'Catalog' AS channel, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, 'Store' AS channel, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk ) SELECT promo_sk, channel, sales_cnt, total_discount, total_profit, avg_discount, avg_profit, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 5 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY avg_profit DESC) AS profit_percentile_within_channel, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS overall_profit_dense_rank FROM promo_agg WHERE promo_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY overall_profit_dense_rank LIMIT 30

WITH cat_cust AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS cat_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk ), store_cust AS ( SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk ), combined_cust AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.cust_sk, s.cust_sk) AS cust_sk, COALESCE(c.cdemo_sk, s.cdemo_sk) AS cdemo_sk, COALESCE(c.cat_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(s.store_net_paid, 0) AS total_net_paid FROM cat_cust c FULL OUTER JOIN store_cust s ON c.cust_sk = s.cust_sk ), ranked_cust AS ( SELECT cdemo_sk, cust_sk, total_net_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cdemo_sk ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS rank_within_demo FROM combined_cust ), latest_time AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk, MAX(cs.cs_sold_time_sk) AS latest_time_sk FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk, MAX(ss.ss_sold_time_sk) AS latest_time_sk FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk ), latest_hour AS ( SELECT lt.cust_sk, t.t_hour AS latest_hour FROM latest_time lt JOIN time_dim t ON lt.latest_time_sk = t.t_time_sk ) SELECT rc.cdemo_sk, rc.cust_sk, rc.total_net_paid, rc.rank_within_demo, CASE WHEN rc.total_net_paid > 20000 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_segment, lh.latest_hour FROM ranked_cust rc LEFT JOIN latest_hour lh ON rc.cust_sk = lh.cust_sk WHERE rc.rank_within_demo <= 5 ORDER BY rc.cdemo_sk, rc.rank_within_demo

WITH cs_detail AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_quantity, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt, cs.cs_sold_time_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, cp.cp_catalog_page_id FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk ), ss_detail AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_net_paid, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt, ss.ss_sold_time_sk FROM store_sales ss ) SELECT COALESCE(cs.cs_item_sk, ss.ss_item_sk) AS item_sk, COALESCE(cs.cp_department, 'UNKNOWN') AS department, COALESCE(cs.cp_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS page_type, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_qty, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_qty, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_quantity) IS NULL THEN 'Store Only' WHEN SUM(ss.ss_quantity) IS NULL THEN 'Catalog Only' WHEN SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > SUM(ss.ss_quantity) THEN 'Catalog Dominates' ELSE 'Store Dominates' END AS sales_channel_dominance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(cs.cs_net_paid),0) + COALESCE(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid),0)) DESC) AS overall_sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(cs.cs_net_paid),0) + COALESCE(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid),0)) DESC) AS sales_percentile, MAX(CASE WHEN cs.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN t.t_hour END) AS catalog_peak_hour, MAX(CASE WHEN ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN t2.t_hour END) AS store_peak_hour FROM cs_detail cs FULL OUTER JOIN ss_detail ss ON cs.cs_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN time_dim t2 ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk GROUP BY COALESCE(cs.cs_item_sk, ss.ss_item_sk), COALESCE(cs.cp_department, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(cs.cp_type, 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY overall_sales_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_state ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) ASC) AS row_num FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 0 AND td.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' GROUP BY w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time ORDER BY row_num

SELECT w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_amount >= 10 GROUP BY w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY amount_rank

SELECT w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS return_amount_cume_dist FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 0 AND w.w_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY') GROUP BY w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time ORDER BY return_amount_cume_dist

SELECT w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, AVG(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_state ORDER BY AVG(cr.cr_refunded_cash) DESC) AS state_cash_percentile FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash BETWEEN 5 AND 100 GROUP BY w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time ORDER BY state_cash_percentile DESC

SELECT w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, MAX(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS max_refunded_cash FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 0 AND sm.sm_type LIKE 'Air%' GROUP BY w.w_state, sm.sm_type, td.t_meal_time HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 500 ORDER BY max_refunded_cash DESC

WITH sales_customers AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, d_sales.d_date, d_sales.d_year FROM customer c JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk), page_customers AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(sc.d_year - sc.c_birth_year) AS total_age_at_sale FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN sales_customers sc ON sc.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number), agg AS (SELECT cp_department, SUM(distinct_customers) AS total_customers, SUM(total_age_at_sale) / SUM(distinct_customers) AS avg_age_across_pages FROM page_customers GROUP BY cp_department) SELECT cp_department, total_customers, avg_age_across_pages FROM agg WHERE total_customers BETWEEN 10 AND 100 ORDER BY total_customers DESC

WITH wp_stats AS ( SELECT wp_customer_sk, SUM(wp_char_count) AS total_char_count, SUM(wp_image_count) AS total_image_count, COUNT(*) AS page_count, MAX(wp_creation_date_sk) AS latest_creation_date FROM web_page GROUP BY wp_customer_sk ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential, ws.total_char_count, ws.page_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ws.total_char_count DESC) AS char_count_rank, CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_high_potential FROM customer c JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk LEFT JOIN wp_stats ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.wp_customer_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY char_count_rank LIMIT 20

WITH cust_agg AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_vehicle_count, COALESCE(SUM(wp.wp_char_count), 0) AS total_char_count FROM customer c JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_vehicle_count ) SELECT ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, AVG(hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count, AVG(total_char_count) AS avg_char_count, CORR(hd_vehicle_count, total_char_count) AS vehicle_char_corr, CASE WHEN CORR(hd_vehicle_count, total_char_count) > 0.5 THEN 'StrongPositive' WHEN CORR(hd_vehicle_count, total_char_count) < -0.5 THEN 'StrongNegative' ELSE 'WeakOrNoCorrelation' END AS correlation_category FROM cust_agg GROUP BY ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY vehicle_char_corr DESC

WITH wp_ordered AS ( SELECT wp.wp_customer_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_image_count, wp.wp_link_count, wp.wp_creation_date_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_customer_sk ORDER BY wp.wp_creation_date_sk) AS rn FROM web_page wp JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk ) SELECT wp_customer_sk, wp_web_page_id, wp_creation_date_sk, SUM(wp_image_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_customer_sk ORDER BY wp_creation_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_image_count, AVG(wp_link_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_customer_sk ORDER BY wp_creation_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_link_count, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, hd_vehicle_count, rn FROM wp_ordered WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY wp_customer_sk, wp_creation_date_sk

WITH promo_agg AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, d_start.d_fy_year AS fy_year, SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN p.p_cost ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_cost, DATE_DIFF('day', d_start.d_date, d_end.d_date) AS duration_days FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, d_start.d_fy_year, d_start.d_date, d_end.d_date ) SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.fy_year, p.total_active_cost, p.duration_days, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.fy_year ORDER BY p.total_active_cost DESC) AS rank_in_fy FROM promo_agg p ORDER BY p.fy_year, rank_in_fy

WITH returns_monthly AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT rm.sr_store_sk, rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq, rm.total_net_loss, rm.return_cnt, rm.avg_return_amt, CASE WHEN rm.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq ORDER BY rm.total_net_loss DESC) AS store_rank_in_month FROM returns_monthly rm ORDER BY rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq, store_rank_in_month LIMIT 100

WITH customer_monthly AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_customer_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_customer_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ), customer_ranked AS ( SELECT cm.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cm.sr_store_sk, cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq ORDER BY cm.total_return_amt DESC) AS customer_rank_in_store_month, LAG(cm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.sr_store_sk, cm.sr_customer_sk ORDER BY cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_return_amt FROM customer_monthly cm ) SELECT cr.sr_store_sk, cr.sr_customer_sk, cr.d_year, cr.d_month_seq, cr.total_return_amt, cr.avg_return_amt, cr.return_cnt, cr.customer_rank_in_store_month, cr.prev_month_return_amt, CASE WHEN cr.prev_month_return_amt IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN cr.prev_month_return_amt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (cr.total_return_amt - cr.prev_month_return_amt) / cr.prev_month_return_amt, 2) END AS mom_change_pct FROM customer_ranked cr WHERE cr.customer_rank_in_store_month <= 5 ORDER BY cr.sr_store_sk, cr.d_year, cr.d_month_seq, cr.customer_rank_in_store_month

SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_close.d_date AS close_date, SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(p.p_promo_id) AS promo_cnt, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS has_tv_promo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.p_cost) DESC) AS site_cost_rank FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_start_date_sk >= ws.web_open_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk <= ws.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d_open.d_date, d_close.d_date ORDER BY total_promo_cost DESC LIMIT 10

WITH promo_returns AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, d_start.d_year AS start_year, d_end.d_year AS end_year, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS promo_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS promo_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, d_start.d_year, d_end.d_year ) SELECT pr.p_promo_id, pr.p_promo_name, pr.start_year, pr.end_year, pr.promo_net_loss, pr.promo_return_amt, pr.return_cnt, ROUND(100.0 * pr.promo_net_loss / SUM(pr.promo_net_loss) OVER (), 2) AS net_loss_pct_of_all_promos, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pr.promo_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM promo_returns pr ORDER BY net_loss_pct_of_all_promos DESC LIMIT 20

WITH returns_by_quarter AS ( SELECT d.d_fy_year, d.d_fy_quarter_seq, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_fy_year, d.d_fy_quarter_seq ), promo_by_quarter AS ( SELECT d_start.d_fy_year, d_start.d_fy_quarter_seq, SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(p.p_promo_id) AS promo_cnt FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk GROUP BY d_start.d_fy_year, d_start.d_fy_quarter_seq ) SELECT rq.d_fy_year, rq.d_fy_quarter_seq, rq.total_net_loss, rq.total_return_amt, rq.return_cnt, COALESCE(pbq.total_promo_cost, 0) AS total_promo_cost, COALESCE(pbq.promo_cnt, 0) AS promo_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(pbq.total_promo_cost, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * rq.total_net_loss / pbq.total_promo_cost, 2) END AS loss_to_promo_cost_pct, AVG(rq.total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY rq.d_fy_year, rq.d_fy_quarter_seq ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS net_loss_4q_moving_avg FROM returns_by_quarter rq LEFT JOIN promo_by_quarter pbq ON rq.d_fy_year = pbq.d_fy_year AND rq.d_fy_quarter_seq = pbq.d_fy_quarter_seq ORDER BY rq.d_fy_year, rq.d_fy_quarter_seq
